name: wakemux
description: Run side tasks as Claude Code threads in cmux worktrees; each thread reports back to the main session and wakes it

prRequiredOrgs.title: Organizations that require PRs
prRequiredOrgs.description: GitHub organizations whose repositories always land threads through a pull request.

copyFiles.title: Files copied into each thread
copyFiles.description: Git-ignored files copied from the main checkout into each new worktree. Empty means .env.

crossReview.title: Cross-provider review command
crossReview.description: Command name of a second reviewer the main session runs before merging, for example codex. Empty means off.
